title: WORKSHEET 17
subject: Future Perfect / Future Perfect Continuous
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 17: Future Perfect / Future Perfect Continuous

sections.instruction: What will life be like in the year 2100? Complete the sentences using WILL HAVE +

questions.prompt: Life [gap] (become) more automated by then.

[gap] (scientists / find) other sources of energy?
How [gap] education [gap] (change)?

Tom is on holiday. He has very little money and he is spending too much too quickly. [gap] Before the end of his holiday, [gap] (he / spend / all his money)
Chuck came to Britain from the US nearly three years ago. Next Monday it will be [gap] exactly three years since he arrived. Next Monday [gap] (he / be / here / exactly three years)
Next year is Ted and Amy’s 25th wedding anniversary. They [gap]
Jane is from New Zealand. She is traveling around Europe at the moment. So far she has [gap] traveled about 1.000 miles. By the end of the trip, [gap] (she / travel) more than 3.000 miles.

I hope you [gap] (not / forget) my name by tomorrow.

If nothing is done one million species that are alive today [gap] (become) extinct in twenty years.
